subject: Can you review the Q4 pricing deck before Thursday?
summary: Alex promised Priya comments on Q4 pricing deck slides 4-9 by Wednesday night, ahead of Thursday Nov 26 deadline.
reason: Alex committed to deliver a review with a close due date, and leadership sees the deck Friday.

messages.body_text:
Hi Alex,

I've put the Q4 pricing deck in the team folder. Could you review slides 4-9 (the tier changes) and leave comments by Thursday, November 26? Leadership sees it Friday morning.

Priya
On it. You'll have my comments by Wednesday night.
